steps.description: Compute quartet and doublet spectra for a trial set
steps.command:
cat > fit.py << 'EOF'
import ts, numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
b3=ts.occ_states(7,3); b1=ts.occ_states(7,1)
Mcf3,M3=ts.build(b3); Mcf1,M1=ts.build(b1)
def spectra(Dq,B,C):
    F2=49*B+7*C; F4=63*C/5
    H3=Dq*Mcf3+F2*M3[2]+F4*M3[4]
    H1=Dq*Mcf1+F2*M1[2]+F4*M1[4]
    q=np.linalg.eigvalsh(H3); d=np.linalg.eigvalsh(H1)
    # remove quartet levels from M_S=1/2 spectrum
    rest=list(d)
    for e in q:
        j=int(np.argmin([abs(x-e) for x in rest])); rest.pop(j)
    return np.sort(q), np.array(sorted(rest))
if __name__=="__main__":
    q,dbl=spectra(1.0,0.0,0.0)
    print("free-ish check Dq=0,B=1,C=0 quartets:",np.round(q,3))
    q,dbl=spectra(615,800,3000)
    print("quartets",np.round(q-q[0],1))
    # group doublets
    print("doublets",np.round(dbl-q[0],1))
EOF

import ts, numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
b3=ts.occ_states(7,3); b1=ts.occ_states(7,1)
Mcf3,M3=ts.build(b3); Mcf1,M1=ts.build(b1)
def spectra(Dq,B,C):
    F2=49*B+7*C; F4=63*C/5
    H3=Dq*Mcf3+F2*M3[2]+F4*M3[4]
    H1=Dq*Mcf1+F2*M1[2]+F4*M1[4]
    q=np.linalg.eigvalsh(H3); d=np.linalg.eigvalsh(H1)
    rest=list(d)
    for e in q:
        j=int(np.argmin([abs(x-e) for x in rest])); rest.pop(j)
    return np.sort(q), np.array(sorted(rest))
if __name__=="__main__":
    q,dbl=spectra(615,800,3000)
    print("quartets rel",np.round(q-q[0],1))
    # collapse doublets into distinct levels
    lv=[]
    for e in dbl:
        if not lv or abs(e-lv[-1][0])>1e-3: lv.append([e,1])
        else: lv[-1][1]+=1
    print("doublet levels rel:",[(round(e-q[0],1),n) for e,n in lv])

steps.description: Fit Dq, B, C to quartet band energies
steps.command:
cat > fit3.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from fit2 import spectra
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
obs={'4T2':6150,'4A2':12400,'4T1P':16850}
def quartet_levels(p):
    Dq,B,C=p
    q,d=spectra(Dq,B,C)
    t1=q[0]; 
    # 3-fold levels & singlet
    return q
def model_q(p):
    q,_=spectra(p[0],p[1],p[2])
    q=q-q[0]
    # identify: ground triplet = 0; 4T2 = next triplet; 4A2 = singlet; 4T1P = top triplet
    t2=q[3]; a2=q[6]; t1p=q[7]
    return np.array([t2,a2,t1p])
def res(p):
    m=model_q(p); return (m-np.array([6150,12400,16850]))/100.
sol=least_squares(res,[615,800,3000],x_scale=[100,100,500],bounds=([300,300,1000],[1000,1500,6000]))
print("quartet fit Dq,B,C:",sol.x, res(sol.x)*100)
p=sol.x
q,d=spectra(*p)
lv=[]
for e in d:
    if not lv or abs(e-lv[-1][0])>1e-3: lv.append([e,1])
    else: lv[-1][1]+=1
print("doublet levels rel:",[(round(float(e-q[0]),0),n) for e,n in lv][:10])
EOF

steps.command:

import numpy as np
from fit2 import spectra
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def mq(p):
    q,_=spectra(p[0],p[1],0)
    q=q-q[0]
    return np.array([q[3],q[6],q[7]])
obs=np.array([6150,12400,16850.])
for s in [(615,800),(650,900),(700,700),(600,1000)]:
    sol=least_squares(lambda p: (mq(p)-obs)/10., s, bounds=([300,300],[1200,1500]))
    print(np.round(sol.x,1), np.round(mq(sol.x)-obs,1), sol.cost)

        else: lv[-1][1]+=1
    return q,lv
def model(p,cand):
    global spectra_ground
    q,d=spectra(p[0],p[1],p[2]); spectra_ground=q
    qq=q-q[0]
    dd=[]
    for e in d:
        e=e-q[0]
        if not dd or abs(e-dd[-1][0])>1e-3: dd.append([e,1])
        else: dd[-1][1]+=1
    trip=[e for e,n in dd if n==3]
    return np.array([qq[3],qq[6],qq[7],trip[cand]])
for cand in range(0,6):

    best=None

        except Exception as ex: continue
        if best is None or sol.cost<best.cost: best=sol
    print(cand, np.round(best.x,1), np.round(model(best.x,cand),0), round(best.cost,1))
